executive_summary.key_finding: Both services show excellent runtime health (99.9%+ success) but poor deployment metrics (25-80% success). The primary root cause is FALSE POSITIVE deployment failure tracking - ReplicaSet 'roll over' events are normal ArgoCD behavior, not actual failures.
executive_summary.true_failure_modes: Only 3-4 genuine failure patterns identified across both services, all with low operational impact.

criterion_1.criterion: Correlate deployments with spikes in error rates or system alerts
findings: NO correlation found between deployment timestamps and error rate spikes
whisper-stt: 4 deployment events on 2026-07-08, but 0% runtime errors
pbx-web: Rollback on 2026-07-13, but only 0.092% error rate
Runtime errors are independent of deployment events

patterns: ReplicaSet RollOver (Normal ArgoCD behavior - false positive)

common_failure_patterns.name: ReplicaSet RollOver
common_failure_patterns.description: ArgoCD creates new ReplicaSets that replace old ones during normal deployments
common_failure_patterns.root_cause: Metrics incorrectly classify normal ReplicaSet lifecycle as failures
common_failure_patterns.mitigation: Adjust failure tracking to exclude normal ReplicaSet roll over events

common_failure_patterns.name: Rapid Deployment Iteration
common_failure_patterns.root_cause: Initial deployment configuration issues (health checks, resource limits)
common_failure_patterns.mitigation: Pre-deployment validation of resource limits and health check configurations

common_failure_patterns.name: Scale Down Events
common_failure_patterns.description: Pod scaled down or failed on 2026-07-28
common_failure_patterns.root_cause: Possible resource constraints, health check failures, or manual scaling
common_failure_patterns.mitigation: Investigate resource limits, health check configuration, and cluster events

common_failure_patterns.name: Network Connection Resets
common_failure_patterns.description: Recording fetch failures with 'Connection reset by peer' errors
common_failure_patterns.root_cause: Network dependency instability (recording service restarts, timeouts)
common_failure_patterns.mitigation: Add retry logic with exponential backoff for recording fetch operations

common_failure_patterns.name: HTTP 4xx Client Errors
common_failure_patterns.description: Client-side request errors (malformed URLs, invalid parameters)
common_failure_patterns.root_cause: Configuration or usage issues with pbx-web API endpoints
common_failure_patterns.mitigation: Add request validation and improve API documentation

shared_patterns.note: Affects both services equally - this is normal behavior, not a failure
